correctness.rationale: The proof specifies exact facet predicates, integer m>=4 quantification, two explicit uniform elementary collapse families with verified free cofaces and counts, all surviving simplices and crown-interface relations, then uses unit relative 1/2 CW cancellations. The 2m surviving diagonal edges have pairs of triangles whose second paths wind exactly once around the lone four-bridge S1; one kills it integrally and 2m−1 become free 2-spheres. Four simply connected row boundaries contribute S^{m-2}. A self-contained stand-alone verifier reconstructs the complete face sets and mod-2 chains for m=4..7 independently and verifies all proposed elementary collapses. The finite check is not used to infer an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The previously classified K_m□C_n open-neighborhood theorem works only for n>=5 because opposite-layer pairs then have unique center. The four-cycle is the natural first excluded boundary: center doubling destroys the essential S1 and creates exactly 2m−1 extra S2 summands. This complete all-width homotopy classification repairs a structural gap in a motivated family; the known m=5 special case is expressly credited. No arbitrary parameter slice or purely numerical minor improvement is claimed.
